reasons: Process independence and almost-sure consistency identify the latent regression only almost everywhere in dose. Continuity of the stratum-specific causal mean, together with continuity of the Sobolev regression and the density lower bound, extends that equality to every target dose required by a simultaneous band. (not crux: This regularity condition only selects the pointwise version after an almost-everywhere causal equality; it does not posit the identifying formula or any inference conclusion.)

Coordinatewise weak unconfoundedness does not control the treatment-dependent diagonal of an uncountable potential-outcome process. The spike-schedule witness in the ADRF obligation satisfies every frozen coordinatewise independence statement but is excluded by full-process conditional independence. This strengthening remains compatible with Bernoulli potential outcomes generated from an independent common uniform variable. (not crux: This is a standard causal exchangeability refinement; it does not assume analytic measurement-error identification, a stability modulus, a rate, or the lower construction.)

verdict.note: High-effort adjudication: continuity is non-crux version regularity; reject inadequate uncountable-process sigma-field independence. Statement replacement loss is text-identical; repair unmarked reduction dependency provenance separately.
